 USER[\"USER<br/><br/>HR / Executive\"]

 STREAMLIT[\"STREAMLIT APPLICATION<br/><br/>Interactive UI<br/>Pages 1–4\"]

end

subgraph ANALYTICS[\"ANALYTICS & QUERY\"]
 direction TB

end

subgraph DATAWAREHOUSE[\"OLAP DATA WAREHOUSE\"]
 direction TB

end

subgraph ETL_LAYER[\"ETL PIPELINE\"]
 direction TB

end

ETL --> SCD

subgraph OLTP_LAYER[\"OLTP DATABASE\"]
 direction TB
 OLTP[\"OLTP MYSQL<br/><br/>Operational Database<br/><br/>Employees<br/>Departments<br/>Projects<br/>Assignments<br/>Reviews\"]
end

OLTP -->|\"Extract\"| ETL

 PYTHON --> DB
end

DB -->|\"Operational Data Access\"| OLTP

subgraph CLOUD_DB[\"CLOUD DATABASE HOSTING\"]
 direction TB

end

AIVEN -.->|\"Hosts\"| OLTP
AIVEN -.->|\"Hosts\"| OLAP

subgraph VERSION[\"VERSION CONTROL & DEPLOYMENT\"]
 direction TB
 GITHUB[\"GITHUB<br/><br/>Source Code + Repository\"]

 GITHUB -->|\"Deploy\"| CLOUD
end
